entities.summary: Johann Baptist von Hirscher was a German Catholic theologian associated with the Catholic Tübingen school. He exerted a great influence in the areas of moral theology, homiletics, and catechetics. Johann Baptist von Hirscher was a religious figures from Bodnegg (1788-01-20, Bodnegg–1865-09-04).
